item.text: Hi, I wanted to share a quick note about one of your staff members who helped me during my recent visit. They were patient while I decided what to order, answered my questions clearly, and made sure I had everything I needed. Even with other customers waiting, they were friendly and attentive without making me feel rushed. I appreciated their thoughtfulness, and it made my visit more enjoyable. Please pass along my thanks—it’s good to see their care reflected in the service.
